mentions.name: PAM Postgres
mentions.description: This Go tool handles requesting access to private and sensitive Postgres databases. Users declare the databases, tables and specific permissions they need; an operator reviews the request, and on approval it generates a temporary Postgres user with just those permissions. All database connections are proxied through the app with random, short-lived hostnames and ports so internal database hosts are not exposed, and SQL statements from user sessions can optionally be logged.
mentions.problem: Helps organizations reduce handing out long-lived Postgres credentials with broad permissions.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on a tool in golang to handle requesting access to private and sensitive databases in Postgres. The goal is to help orgs reduce handing out long-lived postgres creds with broad permissions.
